themes.consensus_view: Most banks see big tech's massive AI spending as still ramping and a key earnings driver, while one shop warns hyperscaler free cash flow could collapse as that spending drains cash.

facts_agreed.claim: AI remains a primary driver of earnings and capital spending across big tech and its supply chain.

themes.consensus_view: Banks disagree on how fast central banks will cut rates: UBS thinks markets overestimate the chance of tightening, while ING thinks markets are too optimistic about quick cuts because oil-driven inflation could keep rates higher for longer.

facts_contested.claim: pace of central bank rate cuts
facts_contested.for_evidence: markets have exaggerated the risk that central banks will tighten policy
facts_contested.against_evidence: Rates could fall slower than growing optimism suggests
